children: Egyptian developer Madinet Masr has entered the North Coast market for the first time through a 101-acre real estate project being developed in collaboration with Reedy Development.

The project, located at kilometre 183 on Egypt’s North Coast, is the first development to be undertaken through AMAR by Madinet Masr, a new platform created by the company to pursue real estate opportunities, according to a press statement issued by the developer.

Under the partnership, Reedy Development will act as master developer, responsible for the development and management of the project, while Madinet Masr subsidiary Doors Real Estate will be the exclusive sales and marketing arm.
AMAR will provide the framework and standards governing the collaboration, Madinet Masr said in its statement.

AMAR by Madinet Masr platform has been created to allow the EGX-listed company to pursue projects using different combinations of partners, capital and operating models rather than undertaking every development function itself. AMAR could participate in future projects through investment, commercialisation, operations, services, brand licensing and partnership structures.
Further details of the North Coast development, including its masterplan, development components and launch plans, will be announced later, the statement added.
The announcement did not disclose the agreement structure, project investment, unit count, built-up area, construction start or completion schedule.
(Writing by Eman Hamed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
